notes.title: Step into the world of Hela
notes.content:
Hela is an open-world, cozy co-op adventure where you play as... a mouse. But not just any mouse! You’re a brave little witch’s familiar with a magical froggy backpack and a whole world to explore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158765/e42a61a406a74819b544d0824e8c9dcff9d50ec5.gif

🌲 Explore, relax, and play your way

It’s all about good vibes, creativity, and having fun with the world around you. Travel through a beautiful Scandinavian-inspired countryside filled with lush forests, wild critters, and nature’s soft magic. 

Whether you’re playing solo, teaming up in 2-player local split-screen, or going online with up to 4 players, there’s always something to discover. And yes—split-screen and online co-op can be mixed together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158765/ae9194168ece5c433691a772e5b08d8b86557d3d.gif

🎻 A world full of stories

You’re stepping in for an ancient, kind-hearted witch who’s fallen ill. While searching for a cure, you’ll help out the local villagers—like Holger, an old violin maker hoping to hold onto a special summer memory with his granddaughter. 

Every corner of the world is full of touching moments, hidden secrets, and places worth poking your nose into.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158765/df178044de55b9c5ae2076a158266e431aa32a06.gif

🧪 Playful mechanics & puzzly fun

You can climb almost anything, swing, glide through the air, and splash through rivers. Your froggy backpack is more than just cute—it’s your best tool for solving physics-based puzzles and getting around. 

Bounce off mushrooms, slide down slopes, or launch yourself with catapults—it’s all about experimenting and finding creative solutions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158765/5216bfdf1f1012715596bb318e5a896660df8c7a.gif

And while Hela shines in co-op, you can absolutely play solo. With the Shade system, you can clone yourself to solve puzzles that would usually require teamwork. (We love clever mice.)

💚 A cozy space to explore, unwind, and smile

At its core, Hela is about slowing down, having fun, and reconnecting with the magic of nature. We want it to feel like a warm forest hug, whether you're climbing trees with friends or watching the sunset alone on a rooftop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158765/88990a7f985930bc9c856e4f2612ad377ee0a2bf.gif

notes.title: Developer Update: January
notes.content:
Hey Community!

2024 was a super busy yet amazing year for us!
From tinkering with the tech to fine-tuning the aesthetics, from planning biomes to designing NPC outfits, our team has been all hands on deck to create an experience that's really going to stick with you for a long time!

We've dedicated time to expanding the World Map, adjusting world elements, and modeling everything to give it that cozy Scandinavian touch. Plus, we've peppered the game with Puzzles, Mini-Games, and Activities to make sure you have tons of fun in this world.

The support we've received from Creators has been incredible—over 22M views, more than a million likes, and thousands of comments from you all! Isn't that awesome?

Take a peek at this post from ekkeeY, who's already hit over 6M views on TikTok! 

Looking ahead to 2025, we're thrilled! Together with our publisher Knights Peak, we'll be bringing you more deets about Hela, which you've all been so curious about!

Check out the new clip from Hela on YouTube!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158765/163dd50f3e1381531579ebd4579b124908210338.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158765/3951497e69f7b5d59da6acd7471803835b40fc2f.gif

notes.title: Developer Update: October
notes.content:
Hello community!

We’ve had a great October - development is progressing well, and we’re happy to see how excited you are about Hela! We received support from several amazing creators, whose content about the game garnered millions of views and a huge number of very positive comments!
We thank both the creators and you for your kind words.

Check out Furo Games on Instagram and MadMorph on TikTok.

We’ve got lots of fun stuff in the works, and we’re looking forward to sharing more soon. 

Take a look at this shot of the witch's house we've prepared for you.
RIP spooktober, hail brew-vember!

notes.title: New Publishing Label, Knights Peak Interactive
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45229324/6c4c893ec63e1618db4e05e59ed818eba6f16fdc.jpg

AMSTERDAM, THE NETHERLANDS, June 10th, 2024 — MY.GAMES, the leading video game developer and publisher headquartered in Amsterdam, announces the launch of its new publishing label, Knights Peak Interactive, with a strong focus on premium PC and console titles. Led by industry veterans Eugenio Vitale, Mario Gerhold, and Jan-Eric Lauble, Knights Peak Interactive aims to elevate gaming experiences through a diverse portfolio of captivating games. The label's commitment to quality, creativity, and player engagement sets it apart in an ever-evolving industry.

Elena Grigorian, CEO of MY.GAMES: „MY.GAMES has gained extensive expertise in free-to-play publishing for mobile, PC and console games over the years, both internal and external. Following our commitment to our players and partners to deliver the best gaming experiences, we will extend our expertise and strengthen our publishing forces in the expanding buy-to-play segment. I'm proud to say we have assembled a very strong team of experts to launch the Knights Peak publishing label and am excited to welcome all our new associates and gamers to our community.“

Eugenio Vitale, Director of Knights Peak Interactive: „We're embarking on an incredible journey. Knights Peak represents a fusion of passion, talent, and boundless creativity. Our team is dedicated to supporting both emerging and established studios in reaching new heights in global markets and brand development. We understand games as portals to immersive stories, offering players a multitude of adventures in a welcoming environment.“

Knights Peak Interactive has already signed initial publishing deals, resulting in a portfolio that currently includes six games: Starship Troopers: Extermination, Nikoderiko, Mandragora, Hela, Pathfinder: Kingmaker and Blast Brigade with more to come.

The Lineup
Starship Troopers: Exterminationis a thrilling First Person sci-fi shooter set in the iconic Starship Troopers universe. Developed by Offworld Industries, the game immerses players in intense battles against arachnid invaders. Launch date for PC/consoles: October 11, 2024.
Nikoderiko: The Magical Worldis a charming platformer featuring adorable mongooses on a magical adventure. Developed by VEA Games, it promises heartwarming moments and delightful gameplay. Launch date for PC/consoles: late 2024.https://store.steampowered.com/app/2374190/Nikoderiko_The_Magical_World/?curator_clanid=45229324
Mandragorais a game where players become powerful Inquisitors, unravel secrets, battle mythical creatures, and shape their destiny. Developed by Primal Game Studio, it invites players into a dark medieval-fantasy world where magic and danger collide. Launch date for PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S: late 2024.https://store.steampowered.com/app/1721060/Mandragora/?curator_clanid=45229324
Helais a heartwarming 3rd-person open-world adventure inspired by Scandinavian Folklore. Created by the minds behind Unravel, it is the debut title from the studio which consists of industry veterans and bright new talent — Windup Games. The heart-warming debut trailer was released exclusively as part of the Gamescom opening.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161310/Hela/?curator_clanid=45229324

Back Catalogue
Pathfinder: Kingmakeris a classic RPG inviting players to explore and conquer the Stolen Lands, filled with rich stories and tactical combat. Developed by Owlcat Games, it is available now on PC, PS4, Xbox One.https://store.steampowered.com/app/640820/Pathfinder_Kingmaker__Enhanced_Plus_Edition/?curator_clanid=45229324
Blast Brigadeis an explosive action-adventure PC/console game combining metroidvania exploration with thrilling combat and a humorous storyline. Developed by MY.GAMES, it is available now on PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One X|S, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch.https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550760/Blast_Brigade_vs_the_Evil_Legion_of_Dr_Cread/?curator_clanid=45229324
[hr][/hr]More news and updates from Knights Peak Interactive will be available soon at: https://knightspeak.com.

notes.title: Developer Update: Welcome to Hela
notes.content:
Welcome to Hela, a heartwarming adventure where you will step into the tiny paws of a little mouse and explore the beautiful Scandinavian landscape.

We would like to thank our community for all the warm comments and support we have received so far; it means a lot to us.

Hela tells the story of the helpful mouse familiars of a friendly witch, who aids local folks in overcoming their challenges. As a tiny mouse in this open world filled with magic, you will embark on a friendly and playful experience, whether playing solo or with friends.

With the help of your companion—a magical froggy backpack—you will be able to interact with the rich world around you, collect items, use its tongue as a grappling hook, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158765/0f05f29ac6a15e2e00b1934287cb871871d4e120.gif

September has been an incredibly busy month for us. The team is hard at work creating more of the magical world you will be traveling through in Hela, focusing on implementing the narrative elements of the main quest, finalizing the map of the entire world, and refining the visual elements of individual biomes, from calm meadows to dangerous caves. 

There is a lot of work going forward in crafting all of the experiences waiting to be explored, filling the space with interactive objects, and also working on the models of people and animals that you will encounter on your journey while trying to help the dear old witch get back on her feet.

Check out an interview with Martin Sahlin (Creative Director) and Jakob Marklund (Technical Director) from Windup Games, the developers of Hela: 
[previewyoutube=YXUdXS_JEOM;full][/previewyoutube]
